[package]
name = "homeassistant-tui"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "A TUI client for Home Assistant"
license = "MIT"

[dependencies]
ratatui = "0.29"
crossterm = "0.28"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
toml = "0.8"
dirs = "6"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
futures = "0.3"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
